Title: NCas_T4_v3-Series VMs are now generally available

Body.Content:
NCas_T4_v3 VMs are now generally available in West US2, West Europe, and Korea Central regions.

NCas_T4_v3Virtual Machines feature 4 NVIDIA T4 GPUs with 16 GB of memory each, up to 64 non-multithreaded AMD EPYC 7V12 (Rome) processor cores, and 448 GiB of system memory.

These virtual machines are ideal to run ML and AI workloads utilizing Cuda, TensorFlow, Pytorch, Caffe, and other frameworks or the graphics workloads using NVIDIA GRID technology.

View the schedule for additional Azure regions availability.

Learn more about HPC performance.
